name: kip-learn-loss
description: Scores how much of the ORIGINAL document's knowledge — entities, properties, relations — survives in the RECONSTRUCTION, ignoring wording and style. Returns a BARE finite number in [0,1] (0 = nothing lost, 1 = nothing preserved): learn() reads this output unwrapped, so an object-wrapped {loss} would score every iteration as infinite loss (ADR-B10d trap 2). Never clamped and never defaulted — an out-of-range or missing score is an honest failed iteration, not a manufactured measurement.
